hook: A dancer on a revenge journey who learns what vengeance costs.
plays: Fast bow/sword support (Hunter Ch 5, Rogue Ch 6, Dancer Ch 9)
pick: You want the strongest free units early (Sirocco, Mu, Olympia) and a support-first lord.
watch: Perform Quests expire in batches (5/28, 9/1, 10/15, 11/27). Anatolia's Paralogue closes 10/14 (Sha Lan). Recruit each bench unit the week its gates land (Jasmine Ch 6 to Halvin Ch 9). Open every cursed chest and hold the items past 11/27 (D-103).
why: Arrives with Guardian from Dietrich's run, the class Catania, Buccar and Sha Lan take. Cataphract isn't open yet.

team.summary: Nine carry Part I: Leda, Sirocco, Buccar, Mu, Olympia and Catania from the start, Guzran from Ch 6, Dadao on the Hammer for Ch 6 to 8, then Esmeralda takes that Hammer from Ch 9 and Inyoni (recruited Ch 9 week 1 at about Lv 15) deploys as the archer from Ch 10. From Ch 9 Leda dances Sirocco, then Guzran, then Inyoni (Esmeralda after a Hammer kill on armored maps), or sings Song of Passion+ when three or more attackers fit in her ring. Buccar and Esmeralda hold the chokes, Mu dodges in the open, and Olympia and Catania both carry Physic from Ch 10. The Arena covers every B rank, so the only Part I side trip is Mu's Brigand (Ch 7 to 8, Regroup). Eight reach Advanced before Part II: Leda's Dancer (Ch 9, free), Olympia Bishop, Sirocco Ovate and Catania Guardian (Ch 10), Buccar Dreadnought and Guzran Shido (Ch 11), Inyoni Sniper and Esmeralda Dreadnought (Ch 12). The Part II bench joins as soon as its gates land (Jasmine Ch 6, Fianna Ch 7, Ludia late Ch 8, Halvin Ch 9; Sha Lan by 10/14), levels in dungeon parties and spare deploy slots, and takes its Specialty exam in Part I at Lv 20.
gaps: Guzran (late Ch 5), Jasmine (Ch 6), Dadao (late Ch 6), Fianna (Ch 7), Esmeralda (late Ch 7), Ludia (late Ch 8), Inyoni and Halvin (Ch 9) join at about Lv 15 in a Beginner class: kills and dances go to the deployed ones, dungeon link attacks to the bench.
Esmeralda sits Ch 8 when Cai and Talimun take slots: run Valhalla Mine and Cindered Road Cave with her for Lv 20 and Armored Knight.

Arena seats are short from Ch 7: Heavy (Buccar, Jasmine, Esmeralda), Mage (Fianna joins Sirocco, Catania, Olympia) and Mounted from Ch 9 (Halvin, Catania, then Sha Lan). Each chapter's routine row says who yields.

Bench units level only in dungeon parties (5 seats) and the paralogue slots: Part II auto-levels anyone below Lv 33 on personal growths only, so their real Part I levels are what carries over. Aim at Lv 30+ by Ch 12 ?
Ch 9 join level is open (Lv 15 or about 25): the plan assumes Lv 15 for Ludia, Inyoni and Halvin. Check Inyoni's level the day she joins.
Mastery speed is undocumented. Mu's Brigand trip ends on a condition: if Regroup is slow, go back to Pugilist by Ch 9 anyway.
Perform Quests: no source says whether they check a stat. If your game shows a requirement, it isn't in any source we found.
Song of Passion+ and Icewater+ depend on reaching Traveler's Garden (Castalia) in Ch 9; that location and the chain order are single-source (fortunesweave.online).
Leda's turn is a Dance or a Song, never both, and her Blaze Gauge can Burst. One source each for the trade-off and the gauge rules.
Part II has no Arena: every bench rank (and Mu's Axe B and Sword B) must be in by 11/27.
Buccar may only join in Ch 9 (he defects on Turn 1 of the Cai battle). Then Jasmine (recruited Ch 6) stands in as the armored tank and Guzran deploys from Ch 5.
Fliers: Catania is the only one. Part III's Hanno and Drake want fliers: she returns to Wing Soldier (certified) for them.
fixes: Dance targets planned, not incidental: Sirocco from Ch 9, then Guzran after a kill, then Inyoni from Ch 10; Esmeralda after a Hammer kill on the armored Ch 9 and Ch 10 maps.
Armor: Dadao's Hammer in Ch 6 to 8, Esmeralda's from Ch 9 (Brawn: Wt 20 to 16), Sirocco's magic and Io's Levin Sword, Guzran's Flyssa.
Physic by Ch 11: Olympia (Bishop) and Catania (Guardian) both learn it at White B in Ch 10; Catania's White comes from the Arena Mage course, not a side trip.
Ch 11 undead: Song of Abjuring over the ring plus Guzran's Cleansing Blade from the Ch 8 map.
Res on the walls: a Hexlock Shield each for Buccar (Dione Fort), Esmeralda (Vandahl barter) and Sha Lan (Dragonbone Tangle); Song of Icewater+ covers the line in Part I.
Warrior gates: Mu and Dadao take the Arena Warrior course (Sword, Axe, Gauntlet) to B; no Pugilist trip.
Charioteer gate: Halvin reads the Rubess Forest Riding Manual the day he joins (Ch 9) and takes the Arena Mounted seat Buccar gives up, for Rider D.

Specialty in Part I at Lv 20: Jasmine Armored Knight (Ch 7), Fianna Priest (Ch 8), Inyoni Archer, Ludia Myrmidon and Halvin Charioteer (late Ch 9). Part II Advanced Licenses: Ch 1 Buccar Guardian, Sirocco Bishop, Mu Warrior, plus any Part I exam that slipped (Inyoni Sniper first). Ch 2 (Lv 35 floor) Dadao Warrior, Jasmine Dreadnought, Fianna Bishop, Sha Lan Guardian. Ch 3 Ludia Shido, Catania Bishop. Ch 4 Sha Lan Bishop. Going back to a certified class costs nothing.
Divine holders: Leda takes The Apsara and Sirocco The Avatar (his Theodora copy aims at the same class, and merging makes them one unit). The Godhand stays with Troy. The Calamity is unclaimed.
Ability slots: every class has 5, and every stage fills all 5 from level, mastery and skill-rank abilities (D-102).
Cursed treasures: open all 8 Part I cursed chests plus Noctula's Claw and hold them past 11/27; Orchel, Eshmel and Anatolia use them in Part III (D-103, D-104).
Part II and III readiness: Before Part II names who answers each late map (Dagda's Deadeye: Halvin; Onager bait: Mu) (D-105).

synergies.title: Dance the caster
synergies.how: Sirocco is the first Dance target from Ch 9: he casts at range 2, Leda steps in behind him and dances, and Special Dance's Spd +3 lets the second cast double. Song of Passion adds Mag +4 (+7 with Passion+).
synergies.payoff: Two casts a turn; Spd +3 from Special Dance can close the 4-AS gap so the second cast doubles

synergies.title: Kill-chain dance
synergies.how: Second Dance target: when he kills and a second foe is in reach, dance him. Spd +3 turns his near-doubles into doubles, and the extra kills catch him up after his Lv 15 join.
synergies.payoff: A second kill per turn; Spd +3 lifts an AS lead of 1–3 to the 4 that doubles

synergies.title: Dance the archer
synergies.how: Third Dance target from Ch 10: shoot, get danced, shoot again from the same tile. Special Dance's Dex +3 adds Hit to her arts, and each kill stacks Crescendo. Leda hands her the Mini Bow and Archer's Ring before the Ch 10 map.
synergies.payoff: Two shots a turn from one tile; Dex +3 adds Hit and Crit, and every kill stacks Crescendo Hit +3

synergies.title: Hammer, then dance
synergies.how: Armored Ch 9 and Ch 10: Esmeralda's Hammer kills a knight, Leda dances her into a second one, and Sirocco's magic takes the rest (it hits Res, not Prt). Dadao does the Hammer job on Ch 7.
synergies.payoff: Hammer is Effective+ (Mt 14 → 42); two armored kills a turn from one Mov 4 unit

synergies.title: Passion volley
synergies.how: Song of Passion ring: on turns where three or more of them can stand within 2 tiles of Leda, she sings first (Str/Mag +4, +7 after Popular Drink Recipes in Ch 9) and they all attack. On other turns she dances instead; she can't do both.
synergies.payoff: Str/Mag +7 for every attacker within 2 tiles until Leda's next phase; pays off once 3 or more swing

synergies.title: Icewater wall
synergies.how: Song of Icewater (Def/Res +4, +7 after Captain's Drink Recipes) on the tank line before an enemy phase you can't avoid, such as Ch 11's Acid and mage songs. Buccar and Esmeralda wear Hexlock Shields on mage maps on top of it.
synergies.payoff: Def/Res +7 on every tank within 2 tiles through the enemy phase, against Acid and mage songs alike

synergies.title: Two tanks, two healers
synergies.how: Two tanks hold the line while two Physic users heal from range, so the strikers never have to stand in front. Catania walks or flies to whichever tank is cut off.
synergies.payoff: Two Physics a turn put HP back on the tanks from range; Catania reaches the one cut off

synergies.title: Undead purge
synergies.how: Ch 11 undead: Song of Abjuring (Leda Lv 10) makes everyone in her ring effective vs undead, Guzran carries the Cleansing Blade, and Inyoni picks off what slips through.
synergies.payoff: Everyone within 2 tiles hits undead at 2x Mt; the Cleansing Blade also cancels the Underworld Boon

synergies.title: Ch 11–12 support meals
synergies.how: Once the recruits are in, Sunday tables build army pairs: Leda + Mu + Guzran, Leda + Sirocco + Olympia, Leda + Esmeralda + Dadao (all three pairs support at each table), then Leda + Dadao + Inyoni and Leda + Lysander + Catania.
synergies.payoff: Three tables raise nine Support pairs a Sunday, all of them inside the army

mechanics.what: Leda-only quests: travel to a town and perform for Renown (150 to 200 each), gold, crates and Leaves; some open map locations. They expire in batches (5/28, 9/1, 10/15, 11/27). No source describes a stat check, a minigame or another unit taking part (RPG Site walkthrough, KeenGamer quest list, fortunesweave.online).
mechanics.impact: No unit trains Cha or any other stat for them. Their value is Renown (Specialty exams in Ch 6, Advanced in Ch 10, Sha Lan at 8, Elegant Drink Recipes at 10) and the shopping on each trip: Killing Edge (Regia) and Flyssa (Zoste) twice, for Guzran and Ludia; Wooden Bows and a Horsekiller Bow (Yaaman) for Leda and Halvin; Wooden Gauntlets (Daimon) for Mu; Da Mina Bows (Orens) for Inyoni and the Da Mina quest; Ji and Short Spears (Port of Pandora) for the spear users. Behind on Renown: clear each Perform Quest the chapter it appears, take a god audience (+50) whenever a temple shows gold, pick For the Empire's Safety in Ch 8 (200 against 30), and run the paralogues (150 each).

mechanics.what: Four Tavern requests in Dagsion, in order: Simple (Sweet Leaves, Traveler's Hill) for Song of Madness, Captain's (Pepper Leaves) for Song of Icewater+, Popular (Bitter Leaves) for Song of Passion+, Elegant (Wonder Leaves from Dance for Benetnasch, Renown 10) for Song of Angels plus Ranger and Troubadour. Pepper and Bitter Leaves share one Search node at Traveler's Garden, past Port of Pandora (fortunesweave.online, community-reported).
mechanics.impact: Do Captain's and Popular on the Ch 9 Port of Pandora trip so Ch 10 to 12 get +7 Songs. Passion (Str/Mag) feeds the strikers, so Sirocco, Guzran, Inyoni and Esmeralda fight from inside Leda's 2-tile ring; Icewater (Def/Res) goes on Buccar, Esmeralda, Mu and Catania; Song of Abjuring (Leda Lv 10) is the Ch 11 undead answer.

mechanics.what: Deliver Hingosh to Baina Oasis in Ch 9 for the Dancer's Necklace; Dancer needs Bow B and Sword B but no exam or License. Dance lets an ally act again, and the Special Dance mastery adds Dex/Spd +3 to the target. One holder at a time (class data, RPG Site).
mechanics.impact: Leda takes the Arena Infantry course (Sword, Bow) every week from Ch 5 to 8, so both B ranks land by Ch 9 with no side trip; she stays Rogue in Ch 6 to 8. Dance order: Sirocco (doubled tomes), Guzran (melee finisher, Spd fix), Inyoni (ranged, Dex fix); Esmeralda after a Hammer kill on armored maps. Ludia is the fourth target in Part II.

mechanics.system: Dance vs Song, and the Blaze Gauge
mechanics.what: Dance spends the action Leda would use for a Song, so each turn is one or the other (AllThings.How, community-reported). Songs fill her Blaze Gauge (+2 each, Madness +3, Angels +4); half full is Overblaze, full is Burst, which strips bonuses for the map and cuts max HP. Underworld Madness sets the gauge to 6 and locks Overblaze; Improviso (Lv 35) lets her attack after a Song in Overblaze.
mechanics.impact: Sing when three or more attackers fit in the ring; dance when one strong unit can kill again. Count her gauge, since Burst on the defeat-condition unit is a real risk. Improviso adds an attack after a Song from Lv 35, never a second Dance. Song of Angels (Renown 10) is once per map: every adjacent ally acts again; save it for the Ch 12 boss turn.

mechanics.what: Leda's exploration talent is performing in taverns for gold and materials. Dagsion's facilities are shared with the other routes: Arena Training from Ch 5 (five courses, each once a week, two seats each), Theater at Renown 7, Thermae at Renown 8, Map > People to find and teleport to recruits.
mechanics.impact: Arena pairs come from the builds: Field Kit > Arena, weeks A and B. Seats go to the bench first (no battle EXP), then exams due now; each trainee sits with a higher-ranked partner for the rank-gap bonus. Part II has no Arena.

mechanics.what: Reading an Archive uses it up and adds its dark spell to that unit's list for good, with no inventory or equipment slot. One copy of each per route.
mechanics.impact: Sirocco reads Archive L (Luna, Aditi's Cave, Ch 9) and Archive θ (Banshee, Iapetus Cavern, Ch 9 to 11, to pin the Ch 11 and 12 bosses at 1-3). Olympia reads Archive Γ (Death: Mt 15, Crit 20) if Vandahl lists it from Ch 10. Skip Archive B (Mire, Mt 3; Cave Behind the Falls, Lv 22) and Archive T (no Pongo source here ?). Banshee weighs 23, Luna 20, Death 13: cast them on turns the caster ends out of reach.

mechanics.what: Every free time from Ch 4: Sunday Inn meals (Leda + 2 targets, 150G; 300G on other days), one gift per target, the Pale Raven, Divine Services and god audiences (about 50 Renown, from Renown 2), the Arena (five courses, two seats each), and Inn auto-activities before long trips. Spare Turns: barter materials first, then a dungeon with the meal pairs, then the Inn.
mechanics.impact: Recruit Support only counts with Leda, so every meal seats her. Ch 5 to 7: Esmeralda sits twice a Sunday (Support 3 with Renown 6), Dadao until Support 2, Jasmine to Support 2 in Ch 6, Fianna to 3 by Ch 7. Ch 8 to 9: Ludia and Halvin to Support 3, then Sha Lan and the fillers. Ch 11 to 12: army pairs. Blessings: Aurora first, then Kalla to Lv 3, Smyrnos to Lv 2, Mars, Jurah, Credna last. If a target is short of Support 3, RPG Site's Ch 9 meal replay loop catches up (Support is global).
